defects.defect: Boss name text 'Goblin chief' and the green boss health bar overlap a semi-transparent debris/skull sprite and the bar is unframed, edge-bleeding off the right screen edge with a second orphan red bar floating below it
defects.direction: Give the boss bar a framed wooden plate with margins on both sides, center the name above it inside the frame, and attach the small red unit bar to its owning unit instead of floating under the boss bar
defects.region: boss name + health bar, arena top (y≈395-480)

defects.defect: Only two of three party mages are on the front line and they overlap the goblin chief's body; the third (Sage) stands alone in the lower-right dead zone, and the whole lower half of the arena is empty, giving a dead, unfinished composition
defects.direction: Stage all three mages in a readable formation opposite the boss with no sprite overlap, and shift the fight group down so the arena's empty lower half is used
defects.region: arena center, units at x≈390-620 y≈530-760

defects.defect: Gold value is visibly truncated as “13...” rather than a readable count.
defects.direction: Fit the full value or reduce type/icon spacing so the resource count remains legible.

defects.defect: Gold value is truncated to '13…' with an ellipsis
defects.direction: Widen the gold chip or abbreviate the value (e.g. 1.3K) so the full amount renders
defects.region: top resource bar, gold coin chip (second pill)

defects.defect: Gold value is truncated to '13…' inside its pill
defects.direction: Widen the pill or abbreviate numerically (e.g. 13.4k) so the full value fits

defects.defect: Unit health bars are missing above the mages and the goblin chief; only one stray red bar exists near the top
defects.direction: Render a small health bar above each unit sprite, anchored to that unit

defects.defect: Boss and front-line heroes overlap heavily, making combatant silhouettes and actions difficult to read.
defects.direction: Separate sprites into clearer combat positions with visible attack spacing.

defects.defect: Stage track is clipped by the left screen edge — the diamond marker at the top is half cut off and the track has no frame or stage labels
defects.direction: Inset the track from the edge, fully show the current-stage marker, and frame it consistently with the rest of the HUD

defects.defect: Smudged semi-transparent ghosted glyphs/number artifacts hover over the sand near the boss name and health bar, reading as a rendering error
defects.direction: Remove or properly animate/fade damage numbers so no stale translucent glyph trails remain
defects.region: top of arena, right of 'Goblin chief' label (~x400-540, y375-430)

defects.defect: All three card HP bars are flat solid green rectangles with no frame, bevel, or texture — reads as plain CSS against the painted, framed art around them
defects.direction: Give the bars a carved wooden/metal frame, gradient fill and inner shadow matching the panel art style

defects.defect: Large empty sand areas make the battle feel sparse while units are split into distant clusters.
defects.direction: Tighten the encounter composition and distribute props or combat activity more intentionally.

defects.defect: A wide flat brown band sits between the sand horizon and the party HUD, and the tent and campfire props are half-clipped by it
defects.direction: Reduce the dead brown band and lift the props fully into the arena, or blend the horizon into the HUD frame

defects.defect: The small red over-unit bar floats detached below the skull trophy pile rather than anchored over the boss sprite
defects.direction: Anchor the boss's over-unit health bar directly above the goblin chief sprite

defects.defect: Portrait medallions are small relative to the card and the hero names sit hard against the right edge of Bastion's card, crowding the frame
defects.direction: Enlarge portraits slightly and balance name padding inside each card

defects.defect: The long green bar plus smaller red bar reads as an ambiguous duplicate health UI.
defects.direction: Clarify the relationship with a single dominant boss health bar or explicit secondary-state styling.
